title.narrative: A project to provide potable water in the Republic of Sudan by digging 24 deep wells

description.narrative: 60,000 people daily, including: 20,000 children, and the approximate number of all, young and old, can be stated as 35,000 thousand females and 25,000 males, to clean water suitable for drinking and human use. - Ensuring the sustainability of 24 medium-depth wells powered by solar energy. - Ensuring the continuity of the targeted wells by training the beneficiaries on operation, maintenance and supervision. - A 3-year warranty on the targeted wells, including maintenance and spare parts after the completion of the project.

Establishing (24) integrated watering stations in the states of the Republic of Sudan, from which about 60,000 people will benefit daily, including: 20,000 children, and the approximate number of all, young and old, can be stated as 35,000 thousand females and 25,000 males.  Ensuring sustainable access to safe water for drinking and household activities  Reducing the incidence of waterborne diseases.  Raising the capacity of the beneficiary community to manage water wells.

Preparing geological studies by a specialized team. - Excavating the selected site using specialized machinery (router digger) with a selection of high-quality materials for packaging and pipes. - 24 drilling holes powered by solar energy - Installing a high quality (Indian) submersible pump (10 HP 7.5 kW, with its accessories) - Operating the well with solar energy, (20) panels, each with a capacity of (550 watts), for a total of (11,000 Watt - Installing a tank with a capacity of (45 cubic meters) of premium iron and a tower with a height of (6 meters).
